principles: Only bind truth rows to code when the implementation or explicit future boundary is already real.
Keep local Lattice CLI evidence separate from Authority Server receipt-backed completion.
Prefer the smallest mechanical mapping change that makes gap_analyze report the truth.
Preserve the locked key-ref and production-safety boundary.
drivers: The user needs the current high-priority gap_analyze reports resolved without false coverage.
The scanner consumes @task title/description/changes text, so the fix must match that mechanical contract.
The key-ref row is a future/blocked Layer 4 requirement, not current implemented support.

options.name: A: Add truthful annotation anchors to existing implementation and boundary files
pros: Clears false high gaps when code or explicit future boundary already exists
Keeps patch small and aligned with gap_analyze mechanics
Does not broaden Authority or production-safety scope
cons: Requires careful wording so annotation text does not overclaim implementation

options.name: B: Implement missing feature paths for all three rows
pros: Would make every row implemented in a broad sense
cons: Would violate the locked key-ref boundary
Would risk Authority Server overclaim without receipt-backed proof

options.name: C: Change gap_analyze matching logic
pros: Could make future scans more sophisticated
cons: Optimization beyond the current correctness issue
Higher regression risk across all truth coverage
Unnecessary if the existing annotation contract can represent the facts

chosen: A: Add truthful annotation anchors to existing implementation and boundary files
rationale: Choose option A because the current evidence shows the first two rows already have smoke or handler coverage and the third row is explicitly future/blocked; annotation anchors are the minimal real correctness fix for gap_analyze truth mapping without arbitrary optimization or Authority overclaim.

preMortem.trigger: Developer writes broad production-safety wording to satisfy keyword matching
preMortem.consequence: gap_analyze turns green while the locked Layer 4 evidence path is still absent
preMortem.mitigation: Wording must state future/blocked boundary only, and validation must grep for forbidden completion booleans or overclaim language in the diff.

preMortem.scenario: A real implementation gap is hidden by annotation text
preMortem.trigger: Existing smoke does not actually cover the cited requirement but the annotation mentions the keyword anyway
preMortem.consequence: The user gets false confidence from a 0-high gap report
preMortem.mitigation: Before editing, inspect the cited docs and smoke/code paths; if coverage is absent, record a finding and keep the checklist blocked.

preMortem.scenario: The scanner remains red after annotation
preMortem.trigger: Annotation text misses the exact keywords extracted from the requirement summary
preMortem.consequence: The user still sees high gaps and the story fails its visible outcome
preMortem.mitigation: Run lattice gap_analyze before and after, and adjust only truthful title/description/changes text consumed by the scanner.

preMortem.scenario: Local evidence is mistaken for Authority completion
preMortem.trigger: The delivery summary or annotation mentions production completion too broadly
preMortem.consequence: Lattice CLI Non-authority evidence is overclaimed as Authority Server proof
preMortem.mitigation: Keep receiptVerified, productionDone, authorityDone, and fullAuthorityDone false or absent; explicitly state no Authority completion is claimed.
